info.title: Mock Exam System API
info.description: REST API for the Mock Exam System. All endpoints except POST /auth/login require a JWT Bearer token.

get.summary: Get a question by ID (includes soft-deleted)

put.summary: Update a question (all fields optional; choices replace entirely if provided)

post.summary: Bulk import questions from a CSV or JSON file

file.description: CSV or JSON file, max 5 MB

get.summary: Pass/fail counts grouped by exam category (all users)
Per-category accuracy for the current user
Score history over time for the current user

post.summary: Login and obtain a JWT token
Submit answers and get the exam result

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by category, e.g. AWS SAA

get.summary: List the current user's past exam results
Get a single result with answer records
Export a result as PDF (stub — returns JSON until dompdf is integrated)

200.description: Result data (or PDF blob when dompdf is integrated)

bearerAuth.description: Obtain a token from POST /auth/login, then click Authorize and paste it here.
